groups.analysis: Rows are admitted increasing from0 below1 with at least2 before rows.len()-1 and width taper. Positive blade width bounded .001..25cm, actual height .82 and species/age/width factors bounded; normal normalization and seed head attachment divisor positive for actual producer. Shared seeds retain near/far/vista species/root correspondence; hard zero density drops blades. Native topology square/capacity/u32 indexing remains unsupported arbitrary positive config, see candidate; current authored counts small. Full1237 body and fixture source read, not run.

Saturating basis points give finite bounded site weights; mesic minimum.001 preserves strictly positive quantized weighted selection, localization35/65 retains it. Neighbourhood caches seed-derived9sites independently of profile then uses current profile, so no cached habitat authority drift. ScenePlanPoint finite but huge coordinates saturate native i32 lattice and +/-1 can overflow; actual bounded scene terrain producer needed before ordinary claim. Placement re-admits computed jittered points, checks terrain height/normal and slope, rejects missing cells; fixed normal comparisons rely canonical normal admission.

Scene preparation builds local vectors, mask errors preserve unpresented scene for retry; disabled grass marks complete intentionally. NearEdge clones actual Near placements. Empty species batches skipped before fitted_batch_aabb, discharging empty min/maxInf helper concern. Scene-wide interaction previous position missing resets state; minimum time1/240 prevents divide byzero but arbitrary huge native displacement can overflow before velocity length clamp, no ordinary interactor producer witness. Smooth/skip uniforms use visual tolerance, no movement authority. Published index/emitted u32 and lattice iteration need bounded topology/scene budget; no ordinary overflow asserted.
